topic.name: 科技、能源与产业
topic.description: 关注人工智能、芯片、太空、能源转型与关键产业
topic.query: technology artificial intelligence semiconductor energy industry

overview: 今日专题“科技、能源与产业”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Khor Mor drone attack raises fears over Iraq’s energy security
items.summary: Drone strike disrupts electricity supply in Iraq's semi-autonomous Kurdish region, renewing concerns about armed groups.
items.titleZh: 科尔莫无人机袭击引发对伊拉克能源安全的担忧
items.summaryZh: 无人机袭击扰乱了伊拉克库尔德自治区的电力供应。此次事件再次引发了人们对武装组织威胁能源基础设施的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了伊拉克能源设施在地区冲突背景下的脆弱性。

items.title: Why is Vietnam’s To Lam in Japan? AI, chips and nuclear power
items.summary: Vietnam’s To Lam is expected to use his visit to Japan this week to expand trade and investment options with Tokyo, especially in technology, amid continued uncertainty surrounding America’s future policy direction. After talks with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in Tokyo on Monday, the two leaders pledged to speed up public-private cooperation on critical minerals, with a joint statement calling economic security a top priority in bilateral relations and promising deeper cooperation on...
items.titleZh: 越南领导人苏林访日：聚焦人工智能、芯片与核能
items.summaryZh: 越南领导人苏林本周访问日本，旨在加强两国在科技、关键矿产及经济安全领域的合作。双方承诺加速公私合作，以应对全球政策不确定性。
items.whyImportant: 越南通过深化与日本的战略合作，旨在提升自身在半导体和能源供应链中的地位，以应对地缘政治风险。

items.title: As 1 mainland Chinese chip IPO soars, another stumbles in busy Hong Kong week
items.summary: Two mainland Chinese chip suppliers made sharply divergent trading debuts in Hong Kong on Tuesday after raising a combined HK$2.2 billion (US$280 million), underscoring investors’ selective appetite for semiconductor stocks despite a pickup in new listings. Suzhou Denglin Technology, the week’s largest listing, fell by as much as 8.6 per cent in morning trade after raising HK$1.4 billion in its initial public offering (IPO). The graphics processing unit maker priced its shares at HK$231 – the...
items.titleZh: 港股芯片股IPO表现分化：一家大涨，一家遇冷
items.summaryZh: 两家中国内地芯片供应商本周在香港上市，表现截然不同。其中，苏州登临科技在IPO中筹集了14亿港元，但上市首日股价下跌超过8%。
items.whyImportant: 这显示出尽管半导体行业受到关注，但投资者对新股的选择正变得更加谨慎和挑剔。

items.title: The superpower battle over energy – and what it means for your bills
items.summary: A tug-of-war between China and the US could have a big impact on energy costs, but who will win?
items.titleZh: 中美能源博弈及其对民众账单的影响
items.summaryZh: 中美两国在能源领域的竞争日益激烈。这种博弈可能会对全球能源价格产生重大影响，进而波及普通消费者的生活成本。
items.whyImportant: 能源安全已成为大国竞争的核心领域，其波动直接关系到全球经济稳定与民生福祉。

items.title: FedEx adds new US-China cargo flights ahead of Xi-Trump meeting
items.summary: American delivery giant FedEx is expanding its trans-Pacific services between China and the United States, adding four weekly flights by cargo aircraft just days ahead of an expected meeting between President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump in Shenzhen. The Memphis-based courier said on Monday that Boeing 777 cargo planes would link Shanghai and Guangzhou with the US, providing additional capacity for advanced manufacturing, semiconductor production, artificial intelligence...
items.titleZh: 联邦快递在习特会前增加中美货运航班
items.summaryZh: 在习近平与特朗普即将于深圳会晤之际，联邦快递宣布增加中美之间的货运航班。此举旨在提升针对先进制造、半导体及人工智能等领域的物流运力。
items.whyImportant: 物流运力的扩张反映了企业对中美经贸关系在关键会晤后可能保持或改善的预期。

items.title: Young people in UK hit by ‘low-gear economy’, warns Bank of England deputy
items.summary: Exclusive: Iran war has fuelled energy price rise and clouded outlook, driving up unemployment, says Clare Lombardelli Young people in Britain are bearing the brunt of a “low-gear economy” as employers hold back from hiring amid the fallout from the war in the Middle East, a deputy governor of the Bank of England has warned. Clare Lombardelli, the Bank’s deputy governor for monetary policy, said the unfolding conflict, which has triggered a surge in energy prices and clouded the outlook for the economy, was contributing to an increase in youth unemployment. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 英国央行副行长警告：年轻人正遭受“低速经济”冲击
items.summaryZh: 英国央行副行长克莱尔·隆巴德利表示，中东战争导致的能源价格上涨和经济前景不明，正迫使雇主缩减招聘。这导致英国年轻人面临更高的失业风险，承受着“低速经济”带来的主要压力。
items.whyImportant: 地缘政治冲突对英国劳动力市场及年轻一代的经济前景产生了直接负面影响。

items.title: Hong Kong customs targets use of astronaut Yang Liwei’s name to sell ‘space oil’
items.summary: Hong Kong customs has requested the removal of e-commerce and social media listings by drug dealers who used the name of Chinese astronaut Yang Liwei as a code name to push “space oil”, also known as etomidate. Yang’s name was just one example of the subtle linguistic workarounds used by illicit vendors to evade platform filters. Customs had made about 64 requests to remove illicit items from platforms including Taobao, JD.com and Pinduoduo since signing agreements with them over the past year,...
items.titleZh: 香港海关打击利用航天员杨利伟名字兜售“太空油”的行为
items.summaryZh: 香港海关要求电商平台下架利用中国航天员杨利伟名字作为代号兜售“太空油”（依托咪酯）的非法商品。海关已与多家电商平台签署协议，持续清理此类违规信息。
items.whyImportant: 此举展示了监管部门在打击新型毒品滥用及维护网络交易环境方面的持续努力。

items.title: Elon Musk and Michael Miebach to join Trump at Apec in Shenzhen. What about Jensen Huang?
items.summary: Top US business leaders, including Tesla and SpaceX chief Elon Musk and Mastercard’s Michael Miebach, are expected to join Donald Trump’s delegation to China for next week’s Apec summit, the South China Morning Post understands. Nvidia chief Jensen Huang had been in talks to join, but his participation is now in doubt amid a controversy that has rocked his company and the wider tech industry. Sources told the SCMP that Musk, Miebach and Huang were among the executives the US president planned to...
items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克和迈克尔·米巴赫将随特朗普出席深圳APEC峰会，黄仁勋会去吗？
items.summaryZh: 据报道，特斯拉首席执行官马斯克和万事达卡首席执行官米巴赫预计将随特朗普前往中国参加APEC峰会。英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋此前曾商讨参会，但因公司近期争议，其行程目前存在变数。
items.whyImportant: 美国商界领袖随总统访华的名单反映了当前中美经贸关系及科技产业的复杂动态。

items.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
items.summary: France on Monday said Iran’s Revolutionary Guards were behind cyberattacks on supermarket fridges in the country last month, vowing sanctions on a European level against Tehran over the first such large-scale cyber sabotage on French territory. Numerous French supermarkets were hit in the October 11 and 12 cyberattacks, which raised the temperatures in their refrigerators, in some cases forcing them to throw away entire inventories of perishable food. “I can confirm that this attack was carried...
items.titleZh: 法国指控伊朗对超市冰箱进行黑客攻击
items.summaryZh: 法国政府称，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队应对上个月针对法国超市的黑客攻击负责。此次攻击导致超市冷藏设备温度升高，造成大量易腐食品损毁，法国誓言将对此实施欧洲层面的制裁。
items.whyImportant: 这是针对法国境内民用基础设施的大规模网络破坏行为，标志着网络战已延伸至民生领域。

items.title: France blames Iran for October supermarket cyberattack
items.summary: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot has blamed the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps for the cyberattack.
items.titleZh: 法国指责伊朗发动十月份超市网络攻击
items.summaryZh: 法国外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗明确指责伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队策划了针对法国超市的网络攻击。该事件引发了法国对国家关键基础设施安全的高度关注。
items.whyImportant: 法国官方的正式指控加剧了其与伊朗之间的外交紧张关系。

items.title: Strait of Hormuz still a source of leverage for Iran
items.summary: Attacks in the Strait of Hormuz put crews at risk and drive up energy shipping costs. Iran's ability to sustain them and the limits of US protection will shape how much trade can continue and at what price.
items.titleZh: 霍尔木兹海峡仍是伊朗的筹码来源
items.summaryZh: 霍尔木兹海峡的袭击事件不仅威胁船员安全，还推高了能源运输成本。伊朗维持袭击的能力以及美国保护措施的局限性，将决定未来贸易的规模与价格。
items.whyImportant: 霍尔木兹海峡作为全球能源运输要道，其安全局势直接影响全球能源价格与供应稳定。

Be brutally honest.” Continue reading...
items.titleZh: “单一民族党”开除赞美希特勒为“史上最佳”的维多利亚州选举候选人
items.summaryZh: 维多利亚州“单一民族党”取消了候选人弗兰科·瓜迪亚尼的参选资格。此前社交媒体曝光其曾称希特勒为“史上最佳”，并发表了涉及伊斯兰教的极端言论。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了政党在选举中对候选人言论审查的严格态度，以及对极端主义言论的零容忍。

items.title: Senate advances bill to speed up permit reviews for infrastructure projects
items.summary: Chamber voted 73-25 to formally take up bill that will shorten timelines to start energy and datacenter projects The Senate on Monday advanced bipartisan legislation aimed at speeding up permitting reviews for datacenters and other infrastructure projects, in the first major action since last week’s election that soundly repudiated Donald Trump and congressional Republicans. The Senate voted 73-25 to formally take up the bill, which senators and the president have pushed as a way to meet growing demand for electricity and other forms of energy that now face years-long delays in getting to the grid. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 美国参议院推进旨在加快基础设施项目许可审查的法案
items.summaryZh: 参议院以73票对25票通过了一项两党法案，旨在缩短数据中心及能源项目的许可审查时间。此举旨在解决电力需求增长与项目审批长期延误之间的矛盾。
items.whyImportant: 该法案的推进显示了美国在应对能源需求增长和基础设施建设滞后方面的政策转向。

items.title: Trump backs Nvidia’s Huang over spy allegations, says Xi may raise case
items.summary: US President Donald Trump said on Monday that Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang had told him he did not know a woman at the centre of espionage allegations was a suspected Chinese spy, and that he believed the technology executive’s account. Speaking to reporters at the White House, Trump said he had spoken to Huang earlier in the day, as the chipmaker faces scrutiny over whether its founder was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. “I asked him that question. Did you have any idea...
items.titleZh: 特朗普力挺英伟达CEO黄仁勋，称其不知涉嫌间谍案，并表示习近平可能提及此事
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普表示，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋向其澄清，自己并不知晓涉嫌间谍案的女子身份。特朗普称相信黄仁勋的说法，并提到习近平可能会在会晤中讨论此案。
items.whyImportant: 此事件涉及美国科技巨头与地缘政治敏感问题的交集，引发了对英伟达创始人是否成为外国情报目标的高度关注。

items.title: Australia to introduce mandatory reporting after OpenAI hack to combat artificial intelligence ‘going rogue’
items.summary: Government flags criminal law changes to ensure companies can’t argue in future ‘that someone didn’t know the computer was loaded’ Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast OpenAI will not face criminal penalties over the Medicare data breach, but the prime minister has flagged changes to Australia’s criminal law to crack down on future breaches by artificial intelligence companies. Anthony Albanese on Tuesday released the recommendations of a “rapid review” into the June breach of a Medicare statistics reporting service portal administered by Services Australia, but not the findings or the report itself, which he committed to releasing in the future. Maintaining security controls across all stages of development and deployment. Identifying and managing serious risks associated with their models. Providing mandatory notification of incidents to the Australian government rapidly. Allowing independent evaluation of their models. Maintaining and publishing safety and security frameworks to ensure good governance, risk management and transparency. Responding to updated standards and rules as technologies change. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚在OpenAI数据泄露后引入强制报告制度，以防人工智能“失控”
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚政府计划修改刑法，要求人工智能公司在发生安全漏洞时必须进行强制报告。此举旨在加强对AI行业的监管，确保企业在模型开发和部署中承担更多安全责任。
items.whyImportant: 该政策反映了各国政府在人工智能快速发展背景下，正通过立法手段强化对科技巨头的监管与问责。

items.title: Donald Trump doubles down on defense of Pete Hegseth and attacks fresh effort to impeach him – as it happened
items.summary: This live blog is now closed. items.titleZh: 特朗普力挺皮特·赫格塞斯并抨击弹劾企图
items.summaryZh: 特朗普继续为皮特·赫格塞斯辩护，同时众议院民主党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯透露，政府将就黄仁勋与涉嫌间谍案女子的关联举行闭门简报会。众议院委员会已要求黄仁勋于11月18日出席听证会。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了美国政坛内部对特朗普政府官员及相关科技界人士安全审查的激烈博弈。

items.title: US reportedly evacuated aircraft from RAF Mildenhall over Iran threat
items.summary: The reported evacuation comes weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford over a suspected Iran-linked security incident The US military evacuated aircraft from a second airbase in ⁠Britain on Monday after a threat from Iran, the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) reported, citing people familiar with the matter, weeks after Washington withdrew its bombers from ⁠RAF Fairford airbase over ⁠a suspected Iran-linked ​security incident. Two US refuelling tankers that were using the RAF Mildenhall military base diverted to Germany earlier on Monday, while several other tankers at the base ⁠were moved to Germany and other locations later in the day, the WSJ report said. items.titleZh: 据报道，由于伊朗威胁，美国从英国米尔登霍尔皇家空军基地撤离了飞机
items.summaryZh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，由于受到伊朗威胁，美国军方已将驻扎在英国米尔登霍尔皇家空军基地的多架加油机转移至德国等地。此前几周，美军也曾因疑似与伊朗有关的安全事件从英国费尔福德空军基地撤离了轰炸机。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了美军在欧洲基地面临的安全压力升级，以及对伊朗潜在威胁的高度警惕。

items.title: Senate advances bill to speed up projects from gas pipelines to clean energy
items.summary: Key environmental groups come out against bipartisan Baaja bill over fears it could spur datacenters and ICE jails The Senate on Monday advanced bipartisan legislation aimed at speeding up permitting reviews for datacenters and other infrastructure projects, in the first major action since last week’s election that soundly repudiated Donald Trump and congressional Republicans. It’s a bill that would make it easier to build big infrastructure projects in America – everything from fossil fuel pipelines to transmission lines that would add more clean energy to the grid. And it would roll back environmental and social protections to achieve this goal. That is why climate advocates are torn over the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs act (Baaja). items.titleZh: 美国参议院推进旨在加速天然气管道及清洁能源项目审批的法案
items.summaryZh: 美国参议院推进了一项两党法案，旨在简化数据中心及能源基础设施项目的审批流程。该法案因可能削弱环境和社会保护措施，在气候倡导者中引发了争议。
items.whyImportant: 该法案若通过，将显著改变美国大型基础设施建设的监管环境，并在经济发展与环境保护之间引发进一步博弈。

items.title: Chinese biotech giant WuXi AppTec’s shares jump after Pentagon blacklist reversal
items.summary: WuXi AppTec’s shares jumped on Tuesday after the Pentagon removed the company from a list of entities allegedly linked to the Chinese military, marking a win for the biotech service giant and raising hopes among other mainland firms challenging US blacklists. The US deputy secretary of defence decided to delist WuXi AppTec from its list of “Chinese military companies”, according to a notice published on the Federal Register on Tuesday. WuXi AppTec surged more than 6 per cent at the open in Hong...
items.titleZh: 五角大楼将药明康德移出黑名单，公司股价应声上涨
items.summaryZh: 美国国防部已将药明康德从所谓的“中国军事企业”名单中移除。这一决定被视为该生物技术巨头的一次重大胜利，也提振了其他面临美国制裁的中国企业信心。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着美国对华生物技术企业制裁政策的潜在调整，对相关企业的国际业务恢复具有重要意义。

items.title: Nvidia scandal may test fragile US-China truce, experts say
items.summary: The fallout from the Nvidia scandal may test the fragile truce between the US and China, analysts say, as calls in Washington grow to tighten semiconductor export controls just days before US President Donald Trump is due to meet Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China. “I think that [scandal] could have a bigger impact down the line during the meeting in Miami or even further down the line,” said Ilaria Mazzocco, a senior fellow at the Centre for Strategic and International Studies....
items.titleZh: 专家称英伟达丑闻可能考验美中之间脆弱的休战状态
items.summaryZh: 分析人士指出，英伟达相关丑闻可能加剧华盛顿收紧半导体出口管制的呼声。这正值美中两国领导人即将举行会晤之际，可能对双边关系产生负面影响。
items.whyImportant: 科技领域的摩擦持续升级，增加了美中高层会晤达成实质性共识的难度。

items.title: Saudi Arabia downs missiles fired at Riyadh after Houthi attack on pipeline
items.summary: Saudi forces intercept two missiles fired towards Riyadh, hours after reporting damage to key East-West pipeline.
items.titleZh: 沙特阿拉伯拦截射向利雅得的导弹，此前输油管道遭胡塞武装袭击
items.summaryZh: 沙特军方拦截了两枚射向首都利雅得的导弹。此前，沙特关键的东-西输油管道刚刚报告遭到袭击并受损。
items.whyImportant: 地区安全局势的恶化直接威胁到全球能源供应基础设施的稳定。

items.title: Chinese men risk lives to support girl stuck between window bars outside 12th-floor home
items.summary: Six individuals in southeastern China were named Good Samaritans by local authorities for risking their lives to save a little girl who was in danger of falling from a high-rise building. The incident unfolded on the morning of October 17 in a residential community in Zhangping, Fujian province. According to Xinhua, a resident shared a picture of a young girl in the community’s online chat group and urged security guards to help. The girl, about three years old, was shown hanging outside the...
items.titleZh: 中国福建多名男子冒生命危险救助被困在12楼窗外的女童
items.summaryZh: 福建省张平市六名男子因在危急时刻合力救助一名悬挂在12楼窗外的三岁女童，被当地政府授予“见义勇为”称号。这一英勇行为在当地社区传为佳话。
items.whyImportant: 该事件展现了社会公众在突发险情中的互助精神，引发了对高层建筑儿童安全问题的广泛关注。

items.title: Cyber-attack on French supermarket freezers has geopolitical context
items.summary: ‘Not particularly complex’ defrosting hack has been attributed to Iran, with presumption it is linked to others across Europe Iranian hackers like to send a message. In 2023 a state-backed group interrupted TV streaming services in the United Arab Emirates to broadcast a deepfake report on the war in Gaza. In the same year, hackers affiliated with Iran displayed the slogan “down with Israel” on the screens of water-control equipment made by an Israeli firm. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 法国超市冷冻设备遭网络攻击，具有地缘政治背景
items.summaryZh: 法国超市冷冻设备近期遭受黑客攻击，调查显示该事件与伊朗有关。此类攻击被视为伊朗通过网络手段向欧洲国家传递政治信号的手段之一。
items.whyImportant: 网络攻击已成为地缘政治博弈的常态化工具，对关键民生基础设施的安全构成了持续威胁。
